title: read_mcp_resource returns MCP resource text to the model without wrapUntrusted(), unlike sibling tools

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue is a valid, clear bug report identifying a security oversight where read_mcp_resource returns raw text without calling wrapUntrusted(), inconsistent with other MCP tools in mcp-tool.ts.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: The fix requires importing and applying wrapUntrusted() to resource text output in packages/core/src/tools/read-mcp-resource.ts and updating corresponding unit tests in packages/core/src/tools/read-mcp-resource.test.ts. This is a localized, single-file logic change.

summary.problem: The read_mcp_resource tool returns MCP resource content directly in llmContent without wrapping it in wrapUntrusted(), unlike sibling MCP tools.
summary.root_cause: ReadMcpResourceToolInvocation.execute in packages/core/src/tools/read-mcp-resource.ts assigns unwrapped resource text to llmContent instead of wrapping it with wrapUntrusted().
summary.context: mcp-tool.ts wraps text and embedded resource text in wrapUntrusted() to mark external MCP content as untrusted for LLM consumption. read_mcp_resource missed this wrapper.

steps: In ReadMcpResourceToolInvocation.execute, wrap contentText using wrapUntrusted(contentText) when assigning llmContent in the returned ToolResult.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: When read_mcp_resource tool is executed, llmContent returned in ToolResult is wrapped with wrapUntrusted().
verification_steps: Update tests in packages/core/src/tools/read-mcp-resource.test.ts to expect llmContent to be wrapped with wrapUntrusted().
Run Vitest test suite on packages/core/src/tools/read-mcp-resource.test.ts to verify all test cases pass.
